mine: who was in charge of the forced labor
note: Hebrew 'al hammas denotes the overseer of the corvée (conscripted labor), the very grievance of v. 4, not a collector of tribute money.

kjv: It is too much for you (Israel) to go up to Jerusalem
mine: You (Israel) have gone up to Jerusalem long enough
note: Hebrew rav lakhem usually means "enough for you" (cf. Deut 1:6); the KJV takes it as "too much, too burdensome," which is possible but less idiomatic.

kjv: made priests of the lowest of the people
mine: appointed priests from among all the people
note: Hebrew miqtsot ha'am means "from the whole extent of the people" (cf. Gen 47:2), i.e. from any tribe rather than Levi; it says nothing about low social standing.
